cellTypeMapping <- function(dfName, author, gemma){
  
  newdf <- left_join(author, gemma, by = "cell_id")
  print("Column names after join:")
print(names(newdf))
  newdf <- newdf %>% 
    select(-sample_id.x,-sample_id.y, -cell_type_uri.x) %>% 
  rename(
    author_cell_type = cell_type.x, 
    gemma_cell_type = cell_type.y, 
    gemma_cell_type_uri = cell_type_uri.y )
  
  newdf <- merge(newdf, GemmaLabels, by.x = "gemma_cell_type", by.y = "gemma_cell_type", all.x = TRUE)
  newdf <- merge(newdf, cellTypeMap, by.x = "author_cell_type", by.y = "author_cell_type", all.x = TRUE)
    assign(dfName, newdf, envir = .GlobalEnv)
}

cellCountPlot <- function(df, plotTitle, type_col, angle, ylim){
  
  ggplot(df, aes(x = type_col, fill = type_col)) +
  geom_bar() +
  geom_text(stat = "count",
            aes(label= ..count..), 
            hjust= -0.1, 
            color = "black", 
            size = 3.5,) +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = plotTitle,
    x = "cell types",
    y = "Count") +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(0, ylim),
      labels = label_comma(),
      expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05)))+
     theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, hjust = 0.5),
        legend.position = "none", 
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7, angle = angle, hjust = 1))
  
}
plotPalette <- c("#ef6489","#d2422e","#925542","#d77d4f","#d9a33d","#847d33","#cdc698","#ccd44b","#7ada45","#4e9042","#556d51","#77dc90","#78ccbf","#86b2d8","#536783","#6e6ac8","#843cd9","#cc4fc0","#894b7b","#d5a0c2")

countPlot <- function(countdf, group_col, fill_col){
  
  group_col <- rlang::sym(group_col)
  fill_col <- rlang::sym(fill_col)
  
  bar_data <- countdf %>%
    group_by(!!group_col, !!fill_col, name = "count")
  
  totals <- bar_data %>%
    group_by(!!group_col) %>%
    summarise(total = sum(n), .groups = "drop")
  
  ggplot(countdf, aes(x = !!group_col, y = n, fill = !!fill_col)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity",
           position = "stack")+
           #position = position_dodge2(width = 1)) +
  labs(
    title = "Mapping of Self Annotations to Author Annotations",
    x = "Number of Self Annotations",
    y = "Count",
    fill = "Author Annotation"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()+
    geom_text(data = totals,
              aes(x = !!group_col, y = total, label = total),
              vjust = -0.5,
              size = 2.6,
              inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  #coord_flip() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = plotPalette) +
  labs(title = "Gemma annotations different from corresponding author annotations",
       x = "Label",
       y = "Count",
       fill = "Gemma annotations") +
    theme( axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7))
}


percentPlot <- function(countdf){

  ggplot(countdf, aes(x = factor(author_cell_type), y = percentage, fill = gemma_abbr)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity"
           # position = "stack")+
           #position = position_dodge2(width = 1)
           ) +
    # geom_text(aes(label = n), size = 3,
    #           position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5)) +
  labs(title = "Percentages of Gemma annotations different from corresponding author annotations",
       x = "Author annotations",
       y = "Percentage",
       fill = "Gemma Annotations") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = plotPalette) +
    # scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format(scale = 1))
  theme( axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7))
}
